text:
Alice: Quick sync — what's the status of the token-cost + latency instrumentation rollout? Need clear owners, backfill plan, and a canary timeline. @Ben @Erin @Claire please confirm ownership and blockers.

Ben: I opened a PR for the new event schema (v2) — https://github.com/redwood/instrumentation/pull/456. Adds token_count, token_cost_usd, and per-stage latency fields. Needs review + naming sanity check.

Ben: sample snippet:```{
  "event": "inference.request",
  "tokens.total": 123,
  "tokens.prompt": 45,
  "cost.usd": 0.00456,
  "latency.kv_cache_ms": 12,
  "latency.decode_ms": 34
}```

Claire: Dashboards will need the exact field prefixes. Can we standardize on `tokens.*`, `cost.*`, `latency.*`? Also we need the backfill window to recompute historical cost and a sample aggregation query.

ci-bot: Build failed for ben/pr-456 — flake8 errors in tests/instrumentation/test_schema.py (https://ci.internal/build/789) :warning:

Erin: Pipeline changes look fine but we need a mapping table migration (adds `cost_usd` DECIMAL(12,6)). Backfill for 30 days estimated ~6h; we can do incremental days to reduce blast radius. Also need a migration for event name from `inference.v1` -> `inference.request`. Ping @Frank for SRE window.

Frank: Schedule canary on Tue 09:00 UTC (low traffic). Rollback plan: revert schema flag + stop backfill, and route traffic to fallback model variant. Add an alert: `token_cost_rate > 2x baseline` during canary.

Alice: OK — owners confirmed: eng-platform (Ben) = schema + rollout; eng-infra (Erin) = pipeline + backfill; analytics (Claire) = dashboards + regression checks; eng-sre (Frank) = monitoring/rollback. Proposed timeline: PR review by EOD Fri, infra migrations Mon, incremental backfill Mon night, canary Tue 09:00 UTC. Any blockers?

Ben: I'll fix the flake errors and push an update today. Will also add a small migration doc in the PR. @devex can you prep a short doc snippet for customers? :pray:

Claire: I'll draft the dashboard migration playbook and the cost-regression evals. Will post queries here by Mon.

Erin: I'll schedule the mapping table migration Mon 02:00 UTC and run backfill in 6h window (incremental). Will publish the runbook + migration SQL in this thread.

Frank: I'll add the canary alert and docs for rollback steps. Also will reserve oncall for Tue 08:30-11:30 UTC.

ci-bot: Build fixed — ben/pr-456 passed CI on retry (https://ci.internal/build/790) :white_check_mark:

Ben: pushed fixes and updated schema names per Claire's suggestion. Link updated in PR.

Alice: Great. Please react with :white_check_mark: when your piece (PR, migration, dashboard playbook, alerts) is ready. If anything slips schedule, ping me here so we can move the canary. Thanks everyone!

devex: Noted — I'll add a short "what changed" blurb for the public quickstart and update the SDK docs to map old -> new fields.

Alice: End-of-thread checklist: 1) PR merged, 2) infra migration runbook posted, 3) backfill completed, 4) dashboards validated, 5) canary executed & monitored.

Ben: ✅ PR merged.

Erin: ✅ Migration runbook posted (link in PR).

Claire: ✅ Dashboards validated in staging.

Frank: ✅ Canary completed, no cost regressions. All good. :tada:
